scope: Human-assisted unvalidated drafts; not published or an automatic RSI result

cards.summary: When geometry changes, identify the affected task relation before interpreting contour difference as identity loss; use the frozen criteria and retain disputes.

claims.claim: Diagnosing the affected source relation can support a successful subsequent repair.
claims.mechanism: Relational identity can survive graphical simplification while substitution can change the scene.
claims.limitations: The historical skyline severity dispute is unresolved; structured failure labels are missing.

cards.summary: When a repair concerns contact, support, emission or occlusion, consider the connected visual relations and authored conflicts; choose an input that still supplies needed information.

claims.claim: Removing an authored conflict while describing a connected target relation can improve the affected requirement.
claims.mechanism: Visibility, material and interaction jointly carry the requested appearance.
claims.comparison: Connected-field wording versus emphasis-only wording remains untested.
claims.limitations: No mask or spatial preservation guarantee; legacy attempts lack the needed diagnosis labels.

cards.summary: When proposing another realization, compare its actual carrier, interaction, conflicts and input with prior attempts; distinguish substantive change from rewording or resampling without forbidding either.

claims.claim: A concrete change after an explicit unrealized requirement can improve that requirement.
claims.mechanism: Changing a failure-producing relation may change the renderer's conditioning, whereas a new name can leave it unchanged.
claims.comparison: No randomized contrast between substantive change and rewording.
claims.limitations: Requires independently reviewed realization labels for a stronger claim; the query alone measures targeted repair after explicit failure.
